specification: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 sections 20.4.1 and 20.4.2: the AC1018 common-entity xdictionary missing bit governs the common handle stream, where a present xdictionary uses hard-owner role. The existing common writer can emit this role, but this alone is not graph closure.

Require final TABLE graph validation to prove a unique dictionary with the TABLE owner and matching hard-owner target. For a narrow generated empty-dictionary control, validate empty membership and common links without inferring the dictionary hardOwner field from the entity handle role.

Before admitting populated sources, validate each membership key, hard/soft ownership role, target type and owner, all XRECORD owner/reactor and embedded references, nested objects, source identity and unsupported opaque state; preserve rollback on duplicates, collisions, missing or wrong targets and late failures.

Verify exact missing-bit and hard-owner field span with following LAYER sentinel, generated whole-file readback in both directions, allocation/late-failure rollback and same-writer retry. Keep proxy and source-binding validation independent.
